local_review.finding_body: The coordinate build declared io.micronaut:micronaut-inject-java:5.1.3 as testImplementation even though the compiler was already present in the required, version-aligned testAnnotationProcessor configuration. This unnecessarily broadened the test classpath and hardcoded a support-module version, contrary to the minimal-scope requirement in §root/FS-test-contract.2.9. The complete finalization pass succeeded after removal, confirming that the extra testImplementation dependency was not needed.
local_review.finding_title: Unnecessary compiler dependency on the runtime test classpath
local_review.fix_note: Removed the redundant, version-pinned micronaut-inject-java testImplementation dependency while retaining the version-aligned annotation processor. The exact Forge finalization command then completed successfully and made no further publishable changes.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the complete single-coordinate diff and local evidence. The tests exercise Micronaut public APIs, use a separate test package, remain version-agnostic in source, run under Native Image without skips or tolerated failures, and contain no scaffold or runtime-class-definition patterns. Only reachability-metadata.json is used. The resolved 0/0 dynamic-access result is a valid no-calls case, so the percentage and entry-count mismatch gates do not apply. Forge finalization passed all three test lanes, metadata validation, test-only metadata routing, style checks, generated-test validity, and statistics generation without further publishable changes.
